To provide a comprehensive overview of the institution's frameworks, UNSRAT structures its vision, mission, goals, objectives, and strategies in an interconnected manner to realize its long-term goal of becoming an 'Excellent University.' The Vision serves as the primary reference for formulating four Missions, which subsequently establish specific Goals, leading to the development of targeted Objectives and Strategies.

Regarding administrative protocols, the student identification coding is systematically structured using specific digits: digits 1–2 indicate the student's year of entry, digits 3–4 represent the Faculty Code (such as 01 for Medicine or 10 for Mathematics and Natural Sciences), digit 5 denotes the academic level (such as 1 for S1 or 2 for S2), and digit 6 signifies the entry status (such as 1 for a new student or 6 for a foreign student).

Furthermore, for academic course registration, students whose active status has been reinstated must utilize Portal INSPIRE to fill out their Study Plan Card (KRS) in accordance with the academic calendar.
